title: 10 Best Hoppers in Colombo
description: The best hoppers in Colombo, Sri Lanka — curated from Reddit. Egg hoppers, string hoppers, milk hoppers & authentic Sri Lankan appa at restaurants locals actually recommend.

places.name: Upali's by Nawaloka

redditQuotes.text: Upali's — hands down. The hoppers are a spectacle in themselves, order them with any curry combination.
redditQuotes.source: — r/srilanka · What are the best restaurants in Colombo?

redditQuotes.text: Upali's is probably the most authentic Sri Lankan restaurant you can find in Colombo. Most locals prefer cooking at home, so when they eat out here, it says something.
redditQuotes.source: — Suitcase Magazine · Insider Guide to Sri Lanka

places.verdict: The single most recommended Sri Lankan restaurant in Colombo on Reddit — a safe, reliable, and delicious introduction to hoppers with a full curry spread.

comparison.best for: First-timers wanting a full Sri Lankan hopper experience with curries
comparison.strengths: 4.1★ from 4,808 reviews · Consistent quality · Tourist-friendly with authentic flavor
comparison.limitations: Can get crowded at dinner; service slows during peak hours
comparison.price / value: Rs 500–1,500 · Excellent value for the quality
comparison.what to order: Egg hoppers with dhal curry, chicken curry, and lunu miris sambol. The hoppers arrive hot from the kitchen with crispy edges and a perfectly set egg. Add a side of pol sambol and seeni sambol for the complete experience.

places.name: Little Cottage

redditQuotes.text: If you'd like to try hoppers with curry, Little Cottage Colombo 8 is the place to go. You can try hoppers with black pork (my favorite), chicken, or fish.
redditQuotes.source: — r/srilanka · Milk hoppers / appa in Colombo

places.verdict: Reddit's top pick for hoppers with curry — especially the legendary black pork curry that locals travel across Colombo for.

comparison.best for: Hoppers with Sri Lankan curry — black pork is the star
comparison.strengths: 4.5★ — highest-rated hopper spot · Intimate neighborhood feel · Exceptional curries
comparison.limitations: Small venue, can be hard to find; less tourist infrastructure
comparison.what to order: Egg hoppers with black pork curry — this is the signature dish. The pork is slow-cooked in dark roasted spices until deeply caramelized. Also try the chicken curry and string hoppers with kiri hodi (coconut milk gravy).

places.verdict: A Colombo institution on Galle Road — affordable, cheerful, and consistently praised for egg hoppers and kottu. Opens at 6 AM for the early birds.

comparison.best for: Affordable egg hoppers and breakfast on Galle Road
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ from 2,060 reviews · Opens early · Great value · Kottu also excellent
comparison.limitations: Can be busy and noisy; basic decor
comparison.what to order: Egg hoppers with lunu miris and dhal. The hoppers arrive fresh off the stove with perfectly crispy edges. The kottu roti is also excellent here — the rhythmic chopping sound carries across the restaurant.

places.name: Green Cabin
places.verdict: A Colombo heritage cafe that's been serving short eats and hoppers since the colonial era — nostalgic, affordable, and the place to eat like a local at 6:30 AM.

comparison.best for: Heritage atmosphere and morning hoppers from 6:30 AM
comparison.strengths: Historic institution · Extremely cheap · Great short eats and desserts
comparison.limitations: 3.9★ reflects inconsistency; quality varies by time of day
comparison.what to order: Plain hoppers and egg hoppers with their house dhal. Also try the patties and rolls — Sri Lankan short eats — from the glass cabinet counter. The wattalappam (coconut custard pudding) is a classic dessert to finish.

places.whatToOrder: Plain hoppers and egg hoppers with their house dhal. Also try the patties and rolls — Sri Lankan short eats — from the glass cabinet counter. The wattalappam (coconut custard pudding) is a classic dessert to finish.

places.name: Pilawoos
places.verdict: Colombo's legendary 24-hour Sri Lankan fast-food institution. Not fancy, but the 2 AM hopper run is a Colombo rite of passage.

comparison.best for: Late-night hoppers at any hour — open 24 hours
comparison.strengths: 3,223 reviews · Open 24/7 · Incredibly cheap · Iconic Colombo institution
comparison.limitations: 3.6★ — chaotic, loud, not for atmosphere seekers
comparison.what to order: Egg hoppers with their spicy lunu miris, and a kottu roti to share. The devilled chicken is also popular. Come at midnight or later for the authentic Pilawoos experience — it's essentially Colombo's answer to a New York pizza slice at 3 AM.

places.name: New Banana Leaf
places.verdict: A beloved Colombo 4 institution for Sri Lankan food served on banana leaves — traditional, generous, and popular with local families.

comparison.best for: Traditional Sri Lankan meal with hoppers on banana leaf
comparison.strengths: 4.0★ from 2,048 reviews · Authentic serving style · Generous portions
comparison.limitations: Split hours: closed 4:30–6 PM; can have queues at lunch
comparison.price / value: Rs 400–1,200 · Great value for a full meal
comparison.what to order: String hoppers with the full curry set — served on a banana leaf with multiple curries, sambol, and papadum. The crab curry (when available) is exceptional and pairs beautifully with hoppers.

places.name: Mr Hopper
places.verdict: A dedicated hopper restaurant with creative variations — from traditional egg hoppers to modern twists. The name says it all.

comparison.best for: Hopper enthusiasts wanting creative variations beyond the classics
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ · Hopper-focused menu · Creative modern takes · Good quality
comparison.limitations: Smaller venue; slightly outside the central tourist area
comparison.what to order: Try the full hopper tasting — egg hopper, milk hopper, and string hoppers with their signature curry selection. They also do creative filled hoppers that you won't find at traditional spots.

places.verdict: A Wellawatte gem for Tamil-style Sri Lankan cooking — excellent string hoppers and distinctive Jaffna-influenced curries that set it apart.

comparison.best for: Tamil-style string hoppers and Jaffna-influenced curries
comparison.strengths: Distinctive Jaffna flavors · Excellent string hoppers · Wellawatte location for Tamil food
comparison.limitations: Basic setting; less well-known among tourists
comparison.what to order: String hoppers (idiyappam) with Jaffna-style crab curry or mutton curry. The Tamil-style dhal and coconut sambol are different from Sinhalese versions — slightly more pungent with curry leaves and mustard seeds.

places.name: Raja Bojun
places.verdict: A Sri Lankan buffet concept with a wide selection of traditional dishes including hoppers — ideal for trying many foods in one sitting.

comparison.best for: Buffet-style Sri Lankan experience with hoppers included
comparison.strengths: 4.0★ from 1,261 reviews · Wide selection · Great for groups · Try-everything format
comparison.limitations: Buffet format means hoppers aren't made to order; more commercial feel
comparison.price / value: Rs 500–1,500 · Good for the buffet breadth
comparison.what to order: The buffet includes egg hoppers, string hoppers, and plain hoppers alongside rice and curry, short eats, and desserts. Start with the hoppers and work through the curries — the cashew curry and dhal are highlights. Good for indecisive eaters who want to sample everything.
